tldr: 美國 5 月 CPI 年增 4.2%、創三年新高，美股重挫、市場改押聯準會年內不降息甚至轉升息。
台股加權指數重挫 1,478.9 點收 43,225.54 點，外資賣超逾 935 億元、台積電除息前棄息賣壓，指數跌破月線。
金管會對台新銀行未通報理專挪用案重罰 1,400 萬元並暫停高資產新戶，象徵財管端誠信與內控監理大幅升級。
6 月多達 12 檔新基金/ETF 開募、00919 單季配息 1 元創高，顯示震盪中 ETF 與收益型商品買盤依舊強勁。
2026 年（民國 115 年）遺產稅免稅額調高至 1,333 萬元、贈與稅每年免稅額 244 萬元，牽動高資產傳承布局。

items.title_zh: 台股重挫近 1,500 點，電子與 AI 供應鏈同步走弱
items.title_en: TAIEX tumbles nearly 1,500 points as tech and AI supply chain crack
items.summary_zh: 台股加權指數 6 月 10 日終場重挫 1,478.9 點（約 3.3%），收在 43,225.54 點，跌破月線，成交值放大至 1.3 兆元。盤面由電子權值股與 AI 供應鏈同步走弱領跌。外資單日大賣超 935.74 億元，三大法人合計賣超 1,173.64 億元、連五個交易日站賣方，僅投信買超。權王台積電（2330）面臨除息前棄息賣壓，股價下跌 50 元、跌幅 2.17%，收 2,255 元。這波修正與美國通膨數據意外偏高、全球風險胃納轉弱同步，後續須觀察月線得失與外資回補時點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX plunged 1,478.9 points (about 3.3%) to close at 43,225.54 on June 10, breaking below its monthly moving average as electronics heavyweights and the AI supply chain sold off in tandem. Turnover swelled to NT$1.3 trillion. Foreign investors sold a net NT$93.5 billion, and the three major institutional groups were net sellers of NT$117.4 billion — a fifth straight session on the sell side, with only domestic investment trusts buying. Index heavyweight TSMC (2330) closed at NT$2,255, down NT$50 or 2.17%, pressured by ex-dividend-related selling ahead of its dividend date. The pullback came as global risk appetite soured on a hot U.S. inflation print.
items.source_name: 聯合新聞網（台股重挫量價榜）

items.title_zh: 除息旺季登場，台積電等十檔個股除息
items.title_en: Dividend season opens as ten stocks including TSMC go ex-dividend
items.summary_zh: 包含台積電、群創、富邦媒等多檔權值與成分股同日除息，機械式蒸發加權指數逾 52 點。除息扣點本屬季節性現象，但適逢風險偏好轉弱，放大了當日跌勢，台積電周邊的棄息賣壓也加重弱勢。市場後續聚焦指數能否順利「填息」——這向來是觀察台股內在動能、邁入暑假財報季的重要指標，也牽動存股族與高息 ETF 的成分股表現。
items.summary_en: A cluster of index constituents — including TSMC, Innolux and momo (Fubon Media) — went ex-dividend, mechanically trimming roughly 52 points from the TAIEX. While ex-dividend drag is a routine seasonal feature, the timing amplified the index's fall during a risk-off session, and "dividend-abandonment" selling around TSMC added to the weakness. Investors will watch whether the market can fill the dividend gap, a traditional gauge of underlying momentum heading into the summer earnings season.
items.source_name: 聯合新聞網（十檔明日除息）

items.title_zh: 台積電重申 2026 美元營收成長逾三成，魏哲家：AI 是根本性需求
items.title_en: TSMC reaffirms 30%+ 2026 USD revenue growth, calls AI a "fundamental" need
items.summary_zh: 台積電董事長魏哲家於股東會重申，維持 2026 年以美元計全年營收成長逾 30% 展望，現金股利至少 24 元，並強調 AI 是「根本性需求」而非短期循環，應用將由資料中心延伸至 PC、智慧型手機、汽車與物聯網。摩根士丹利亦重申對 2026 年 AI 半導體的正向看法，涵蓋台積電、散熱與記憶體族群，為結構性成長提供支撐。即便短線指數震盪，先進製程與 AI 算力的長線需求仍是台股的核心主軸，後續觀察客戶資本支出與下半年拉貨力道。
items.summary_en: At its shareholders' meeting, TSMC chair C.C. Wei reiterated guidance for full-year 2026 revenue growth of more than 30% in USD terms and a cash dividend of at least NT$24, framing AI demand as a "fundamental" rather than cyclical driver. Wei said AI is moving beyond data centers into PCs, smartphones, autos and IoT. Morgan Stanley separately reiterated constructive 2026 AI-semiconductor targets spanning TSMC, thermal-management and memory names, reinforcing the structural growth narrative even amid near-term index volatility.

items.title_zh: 工研院估 2026 台灣半導體產值上看 7 兆元，AI 為五年成長主力
items.title_en: ITRI sees Taiwan's chip output topping NT$7 trillion in 2026 on AI build-out
items.summary_zh: 工研院預估，在 AI 伺服器、高效能運算晶片與資料中心大規模備貨潮帶動下，2026 年台灣半導體產值上看新台幣 7 兆元，AI 半導體將是未來五年的成長主力。此一展望支撐晶圓代工、先進封裝、測試到整體電子供應鏈的資本支出與投資動能。即便大盤受總經消息面影響短線震盪，AI 算力競賽帶來的結構性需求，仍為台灣半導體產業中長期成長提供堅實底氣，後續可觀察先進製程擴產與供應鏈訂單能見度。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute projects the island's semiconductor output value will reach around NT$7 trillion in 2026, with AI semiconductors the primary growth engine for the next five years. The forecast rides a wave of AI servers, high-performance computing chips and large-scale data-center inventory build. The structural demand underpins capex across foundry, advanced packaging, testing and the broader electronics supply chain, even as headline indices wobble on macro headlines.
items.source_name: 自由評論網（半導體產值邁 7 兆）

items.title_zh: Google 砸鉅資衝 AI，外媒點名台積電為最大贏家之一
items.title_en: Google's multi-trillion AI spend flagged as a TSMC tailwind
items.summary_zh: 外媒報導，包括 Google 在內的雲端巨頭正投入以兆元計的龐大資金擴建 AI 基礎設施，台積電被點名為最大受惠者之一。AI 加速器與客製化晶片需求暴增，直接挹注最先進製程產能，而這正是台積電的優勢所在。報導凸顯雲端資本支出循環、而非消費性電子，已成為牽動台灣先進製程稼動率與 AI 供應鏈獲利的關鍵變數。對投資人而言，追蹤大型雲端業者的資本支出指引，將比傳統終端銷售更能反映台廠後續訂單動能。
items.summary_en: Foreign media named TSMC among the biggest beneficiaries as hyperscalers including Google pour vast sums — cited at the trillions-of-NT$ scale — into AI infrastructure. Surging demand for AI accelerators and custom silicon flows directly to leading-edge foundry capacity, where TSMC dominates. The report underscores how cloud capex cycles, rather than consumer electronics, are now the swing factor for Taiwan's advanced-node loadings and the earnings of its AI supply chain.
items.source_name: ETtoday 財經雲（Google 衝 AI 點名贏家）

items.title_zh: 金管會重罰台新銀 1,400 萬元，未通報理專挪用案創首例
items.title_en: FSC hits Taishin Bank with record NT$14m fine for unreported embezzlement
items.summary_zh: 金管會核處台新銀行罰鍰 1,400 萬元，並停止受理新客戶辦理高資產適用之金融商品及服務、及高雄資產管理專區試辦業務一個月。起因為該行前理財專員於 2021 年 12 月至 2023 年 10 月間，挪用兩名高齡客戶款項約 157 萬元。最關鍵的是，本案為首例因「未依規定通報重大偶發事件」而遭裁罰——金檢發現該行內部兩度決定不向主管機關通報。台新並須增提作業風險資本約 26 億元。此案凸顯監理對誠信、內控與即時通報的高度要求，對各銀行財管端的法遵與通報機制具高度警示意義。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission fined Taishin Bank NT$14 million and suspended its acceptance of new high-net-worth clients (and new clients at its Kaohsiung asset-management pilot zone) for one month, after a former wealth-management officer misappropriated about NT$1.57 million from two elderly clients between December 2021 and October 2023. Crucially, this is the first penalty driven primarily by the bank's failure to report a major contingency to regulators — examiners found the bank twice decided internally not to notify the FSC. The bank must also set aside an extra NT$2.6 billion in operational-risk capital. The case signals sharply tougher conduct, internal-control and disclosure expectations across banks' wealth-management arms.

items.title_zh: 金管會修正保險業內控稽核辦法，強化資安防護力
items.title_en: FSC amends insurers' internal-control rules to harden cyber defenses
items.summary_zh: 金管會修正發布「保險業內部控制及稽核制度實施辦法」，全面增強保險業的資訊安全防護。此次修法呼應監理機關在多起事件後，將資安韌性與作業風險治理深植金融機構的政策方向，並與強制汽車責任險身故/失能理賠上限提高等措施相互搭配。保險業者須在資安控管、稽核涵蓋範圍與通報架構上加大投入，以符合趨嚴的監理標準。對保險與財管通路而言，法遵成本上升的同時，也代表客戶資料保護與商品銷售流程須同步檢視升級，後續可留意子法與檢查重點。
items.summary_en: The FSC revised the Regulations Governing Implementation of Internal Control and Auditing Systems for insurance enterprises, strengthening information-security safeguards across the sector. The amendment reflects regulators' broader push to embed cyber-resilience and operational-risk governance into financial institutions following a string of incidents, and dovetails with parallel moves such as upgraded compulsory auto-insurance death/disability coverage. Insurers will need to invest in security controls, audit coverage and reporting frameworks to meet the tightened standards.
items.source_name: 金管會新聞稿（保險業內控及稽核制度）

items.title_zh: 6 月新基金開募潮達 12 檔，聚焦台股與美股成長主題
items.title_en: June brings a 12-fund launch wave skewed to Taiwan and U.S. growth themes
items.summary_zh: 投信 6 月新募集基金與 ETF 高達 12 檔，以台股、美股為大宗，主題環繞創新與成長動能，並搭配收益較高的債券及多重收益/多重資產基金。以其中 7 檔產品計，被動式 ETF 占 4 檔最多，另有 1 檔主動式 ETF、1 檔債券基金與 1 檔多重資產基金。在市場震盪之際，新商品線仍顯示財管買盤強勁，通路同時提供成長型曝險與收益型配置，以滿足追求殖利率的客戶。對財管顧問而言，產品上架同時也要兼顧客戶風險屬性與資產配置紀律。
items.summary_en: Asset managers are rolling out as many as 12 new funds and ETFs in June, dominated by Taiwan- and U.S.-equity strategies built around innovation and growth, paired with higher-yielding bond and multi-asset/multi-income products. Of one tally of seven new products, passive ETFs were the largest group (four), alongside an active ETF, a bond fund and a multi-asset fund. The pipeline shows wealth-management demand staying robust through the volatility, with distributors leaning into both growth exposure and income to satisfy yield-hungry clients.
items.source_name: 經濟日報（6 月 12 檔新基金開募）

items.title_zh: 00919 宣告單季配息 1 元創掛牌新高，高息 ETF 人氣不墜
items.title_en: 00919 declares record NT$1 quarterly dividend as high-yield ETFs draw crowds
items.summary_zh: 群益台灣精選高息 ETF（00919）宣告 6 月當季配息 1 元，創掛牌以來單季新高，受益人數逾 120 萬人，位居台股 ETF 持有人數前五名。該檔自 2022 年 10 月掛牌，主打高殖利率與季配息，總管理費用率約 0.335%。配息里程碑反映高息 ETF——尤其金融股權重較高者——持續是存股族「累積配息」的核心持有標的，即便股價波動升高，買盤仍穩。對財管顧問而言，須提醒客戶留意填息與成分股調整風險，避免「賺了配息、賠了價差」，並依整體資產配置調節高息與市值型的比重。
items.summary_en: Capital Investment's Capital Taiwan High Dividend ETF (00919) declared a NT$1 distribution for its June quarter, a record since listing, with beneficiary numbers topping 1.2 million — among the top five most widely held Taiwan-listed ETFs. Listed since October 2022 on a high-yield, quarterly-distribution mandate, it carries a total expense ratio of about 0.335%. The payout milestone reflects how income ETFs — especially those weighted toward financials — continue to anchor retail "dividend-stacking" portfolios, even as price volatility rises.

items.title_zh: 台灣 ETF 受益人自 2020 年來暴增逾 11 倍
items.title_en: Taiwan's ETF investor base has exploded more than 11-fold since 2020
items.summary_zh: 台灣 ETF 市場受益人次由 2020 年底約 168 萬，成長至 2026 年 4 月底約 1,855 萬，增幅逾 11 倍；在 AI 熱潮帶動下，元大台灣 50（0050）規模更突破 2 兆元。此一爆發式成長，反映 ETF 已成為台灣家庭儲蓄與定期定額投資的主流工具。對財富管理而言，受益人基數膨脹使資金（與集中度風險）高度集中於少數旗艦商品，投資人對分散配置與配息機制的認知教育更顯重要。顧問端可藉此引導客戶從「單押人氣商品」轉向核心—衛星的整體配置思維，控管下檔風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's ETF market has grown from roughly 1.68 million beneficiaries at end-2020 to about 18.55 million by end-April 2026, an increase of more than 11 times, while AI-driven gains pushed Yuanta Taiwan Top 50 (0050) past NT$2 trillion in assets. The scale-up reflects how ETFs have become the default vehicle for Taiwanese household savings and regular-investment plans. For wealth managers, the swelling base concentrates flows — and concentration risk — in a handful of flagship products, making investor education on diversification and dividend mechanics increasingly important.
items.source_name: 永豐金證券豐雲學堂（2026 存股族最愛 ETF）

items.title_zh: 2026 年遺產稅免稅額升至 1,333 萬元、贈與稅每年 244 萬元
items.title_en: 2026 estate-tax exemption rises to NT$13.33m; gift allowance to NT$2.44m
items.summary_zh: 2026 年（民國 115 年）發生之繼承或贈與案件，遺產稅免稅額調高至新臺幣 1,333 萬元，贈與稅每年免稅額為 244 萬元；此係依物價指數調整，並與綜所稅免稅額、基本生活費、課稅級距同步上調。免稅門檻提高，給予高資產家庭更多以稅務效率進行生前贈與與傳承規劃的空間。實務上，顧問正重新檢視贈與節奏、信託架構，以及與配偶剩餘財產差額分配請求權扣除額的交互運用，以在新參數下優化跨世代財富移轉。建議客戶搭配整體資產盤點與保單、信託工具，分年、分散規劃以降低稅負並兼顧控制權。
items.summary_en: For inheritances and gifts arising in 2026 (ROC year 115), the estate-tax exemption climbs to NT$13.33 million and the annual gift-tax exemption to NT$2.44 million, reflecting inflation-indexed adjustments alongside higher income-tax exemptions, basic-living allowances and bracket thresholds. The higher thresholds give high-net-worth families more headroom for tax-efficient lifetime gifting and succession structuring. Advisors are revisiting gifting cadence, trust arrangements and the interaction with the spousal remaining-property claim deduction to optimize multi-generational transfers under the updated parameters.
items.source_name: 自由電子報地產天下（2026 贈與繼承稅大變革）

items.title_zh: 繼承、受贈不動產，房地合一稅以物價指數調整後評定現值認定
items.title_en: Inherited and gifted property valued at indexed assessed values for house-and-land tax
items.summary_zh: 依房地合一所得稅規定，因繼承或受贈取得之房屋與土地，以繼承或受贈時之房屋評定現值及公告土地現值，按政府發布之消費者物價指數調整後之價值為準。此調整機制影響日後出售時計算課稅所得的取得成本，是家族不動產跨代移轉時反覆出現的規劃重點。隨著房價與物價指數變動，顧問正重新試算繼承不動產的實質稅負，以協助家族做出續抱或處分、以及傳承時點的決策。實務上建議搭配持有年限稅率級距與重購退稅等機制整體評估，避免日後出售面臨高稅率。
items.summary_en: Under the consolidated house-and-land income tax (房地合一稅) rules, property acquired by inheritance or gift is valued using the assessed house value and announced land value at the time of inheritance/gift, adjusted by the government-published consumer price index. This indexing mechanism affects the cost basis used to compute taxable gains on later disposal, and is a recurring planning point for families transferring real estate across generations. With property values and CPI shifting, advisors are recalculating effective tax exposure on inherited real estate to inform hold-versus-sell decisions and succession timing.
items.source_name: 財政部（房地合一稅制設計）

items.title_zh: CPI 飆 4.2% 後，市場聚焦聯準會 6/17 會議
items.title_en: All eyes on the Fed's June 17 meeting after a 4.2% inflation shock
items.summary_zh: 美國 5 月 CPI 年增 4.2%、創 2023 年 4 月以來新高，主因能源價格單月跳漲 3.9%（汽油較一年前漲 40.5%）。期貨市場現預期聯準會年內多數時間按兵不動，並開始押注下一步可能是 12 月「升息」，政策預期大幅重定價。6 月 17 日的 FOMC 決議成為關鍵總經催化劑。對台灣而言，美國利率「更高更久」將牽動新台幣匯率、外資資金流向與利率敏感族群（金融、不動產、高殖利率資產），央行後續政策與匯率調節動向值得密切觀察。
items.summary_en: May U.S. CPI surged to 4.2% year-on-year, the highest since April 2023, driven by a 3.9% monthly jump in energy prices (gasoline up 40.5% from a year earlier). Futures markets now expect the Fed to stay on hold through much of the year, with traders pricing the next move as a possible December hike — a sharp repricing of policy expectations. The June 17 FOMC decision becomes the key macro catalyst; for Taiwan, a higher-for-longer U.S. rate path pressures the NT dollar, foreign-fund flows and rate-sensitive sectors.

items.title_zh: 能源推升通膨，市場預期 ECB 6/11 升息至 2.25%
items.title_en: ECB seen lifting rates to 2.25% on June 11 as energy stokes euro-area inflation
items.summary_zh: 市場幾乎完全押注歐洲央行於 6 月 11 日會議升息 1 碼、將存款利率由 2.00% 上調至 2.25%。背景是中東能源價格走高推升歐元區通膨，加上勞動市場仍具韌性，引發對第二輪效應的疑慮。主要央行同步轉鷹——聯準會傾向偏鷹、歐洲央行升息——將收緊全球金融環境，對風險性資產與新興市場資金流動形成逆風。此一總經背景，對以出口為導向的台灣產業與投資人而言是重要觀察變數，須留意匯率與資金行情的連動。
items.summary_en: Markets price near-certain odds of a 25-basis-point ECB hike to a 2.25% deposit rate at its June 11 meeting, up from 2.00%, after Middle East energy spikes pushed euro-area inflation higher and resilient labor markets raised second-round-effect concerns. A synchronized hawkish tilt by major central banks — the Fed leaning hawkish and the ECB hiking — tightens global financial conditions and is a headwind for risk assets and emerging-market flows, a backdrop Taiwanese exporters and investors are watching closely.

items.title_zh: 熱通膨澆熄降息預期，美股全面重挫
items.title_en: Wall Street sells off hard as hot CPI guts rate-cut hopes
items.summary_zh: 美股 6 月 10 日因通膨數據意外偏高而重挫。那斯達克指數下跌 1.98%、收 25,169.50 點；道瓊工業指數下跌 953 點（-1.87%）、收 49,918.78 點；標普 500 指數下跌 1.62%、收 7,266.99 點，盤中各主要類股逐一翻黑，指數收在接近當日低點。此波修正與 5 月底創新高形成劇烈反差——4.2% 的 CPI 迫使投資人放棄聯準會短線降息的期待，並轉向押注年底可能升息。風險偏好驟降也外溢至亞股，台股同步受壓，後續須觀察通膨是否續揚與央行表態。
items.summary_en: U.S. stocks slumped on June 10 after the inflation surprise. The Nasdaq fell 1.98% to 25,169.50, the Dow dropped 953 points (-1.87%) to 49,918.78, and the S&P 500 lost 1.62% to 7,266.99, with major sectors turning red through the session and indexes closing near their lows. The move marks a sharp reversal from late-May record highs, as the 4.2% CPI print forced investors to abandon expectations for near-term Fed easing and reprice toward a possible year-end hike.

items.title_zh: 油價在 90~100 美元間整理，伊朗戰爭溢價部分回吐
items.title_en: Oil hovers around $90–100 as Iran-war premium partly unwinds
items.summary_zh: 在 2026 年伊朗戰爭高峰、市場憂心荷莫茲海峽油流中斷之際，布蘭特原油一度飆破每桶 120 美元；其後因對美伊停火、可望重啟航運的樂觀預期升溫，油價已自 2026 年高點回落約 20%，布蘭特近期約在 92 美元。分析師預期，在持久和平更明朗前，受限於基礎設施受損與油輪安全風險，油價將維持在 90~100 美元區間。能源仍是牽動全球通膨與各國央行政策的主導變數，亦是近期美歐通膨竄高的核心推手，後續地緣情勢與停火進展為關鍵。
items.summary_en: After Brent crude spiked past US$120 a barrel at the peak of the 2026 Iran war on fears of disrupted Strait of Hormuz flows, prices have since tumbled roughly 20% from 2026 highs — Brent recently near US$92 — on optimism over a U.S.-Iran ceasefire that could reopen shipping. Analysts expect crude to stay between US$90 and US$100 until a durable peace is clearer, given lingering infrastructure damage and tanker-security risks. Energy remains the dominant swing factor for global inflation and central-bank policy.

items.title_en: U.S. inflation hits 4.2%, highest in three years (2026-06-10)
items.summary_zh: 美國 5 月 CPI 月增 0.5%、年增 4.2%，為 2023 年 4 月以來最高；核心 CPI 月增 0.2%、年增 2.9%。漲幅主要來自能源：單月跳漲 3.9%、12 個月累計上漲 23.5%，汽油較一年前大漲 40.5%。市場解讀此數據將使聯準會維持按兵不動，下一步甚至可能是 12 月升息。
items.summary_en: The May consumer price index rose 0.5% on the month and 4.2% year-on-year, the hottest since April 2023, with core CPI up 0.2% monthly and 2.9% annually. Energy did the damage — prices jumped 3.9% on the month, up 23.5% over 12 months, with gasoline up 40.5% year-on-year. Markets read it as keeping the Fed on hold, with the next move potentially a December hike.

items.title_zh: 通膨突破 4%，伊朗戰爭推升能源成本（2026-06-10）
items.title_en: Inflation tops 4% as Iran war fuels energy costs (2026-06-10)
items.summary_zh: CBS 報導，美國 5 月通膨三年多來首度突破 4%，並將此波竄升歸因於戰爭推動的能源價格。報導點出此事對政府與聯準會的政治壓力——家庭面臨更高的加油與水電帳單，使「政策該如何因應供給面衝擊型通膨」的爭論更趨白熱化。
items.summary_en: CBS reported May inflation breaching 4% for the first time in over three years, tying the surge to war-driven energy prices. The report frames the political stakes for the administration and the Fed as households feel higher pump and utility bills, sharpening the debate over how policymakers respond to a supply-shock-led inflation spike.

items.title_zh: 道瓊重挫近千點，股市因 CPI 下跌（2026-06-10）
items.title_en: Dow sheds nearly 1,000 points as stocks slide on CPI (2026-06-10)
items.summary_zh: 美國主要指數於通膨數據公布後收在接近當日低點：那斯達克下跌 1.98% 至 25,169.50，道瓊下跌 953 點（-1.87%）至 49,918.78，標普 500 下跌 1.62% 至 7,266.99。這波賣壓反映市場對聯準會預期的快速重定價，以及由科技股領跌的全面性類股走弱。
items.summary_en: Major U.S. indexes closed near session lows after the inflation print: Nasdaq -1.98% to 25,169.50, Dow -953 points (-1.87%) to 49,918.78, S&P 500 -1.62% to 7,266.99. The selloff reflected a rapid repricing of Fed expectations and broad sector weakness led by tech.

items.title_zh: 5 月通膨跳升推高聯準會升息機率（2026-06-10）
items.title_en: May inflation jump fuels Fed hike odds (2026-06-10)
items.summary_zh: 在 CPI 升至三年高點 4.2% 之際，交易員調高了聯準會下一步為「升息」而非降息的機率。市場普遍預期 FOMC 將於 6 月 17 日決議維持利率不變，並密切檢視官員對通膨再加速的擔憂程度。
items.summary_en: With CPI at a three-year high of 4.2%, traders pushed up the probability that the Fed's next move is a rate hike rather than a cut. Markets broadly expect the FOMC to hold at its June 17 decision while scrutinizing how worried officials are about the inflation re-acceleration.

items.title_zh: 分析：能源驅動的通膨「暫時可控」（2026-06-10）
items.title_en: Energy-driven inflation 'contained, for now' — analysis (2026-06-10)
items.summary_zh: Morningstar 對 4.2% 數據的解讀認為，此波竄升集中於能源、且大致符合預期，核心指標較整體溫和。重點在於：這是供給面衝擊型的尖峰、而非全面性的需求拉動型通膨，這使聯準會的政策轉向更為複雜，但尚不至於被迫立即行動。
items.summary_en: Morningstar's read on the 4.2% print argues the surge is concentrated in energy and broadly in line with forecasts, with core measures cooler than the headline. The takeaway: a supply-shock spike rather than broad-based demand-pull inflation, which complicates — but does not yet force — a Fed policy shift.

items.title_zh: Adobe 6/11 公布第二季財報，市場預期 EPS 5.81 美元（2026-06-11）
items.title_en: Adobe reports Q2 results June 11; Street eyes $5.81 EPS (2026-06-11)
items.summary_zh: Adobe 將於 6 月 11 日盤後公布會計年度第二季財報，分析師預期 EPS 約 5.81 美元、營收約 64.5 億美元（彙整 28 位分析師）。此次財報適逢市場氣氛緊張、且軟體業 AI 變現能力受高度檢視之際，財測指引與 AI 需求動能的任何訊息，都將是科技股投資人關注焦點。
items.summary_en: Adobe reports fiscal Q2 after the close on June 11, with analysts expecting about $5.81 EPS on roughly $6.45 billion revenue, drawing on 28 analysts. The print lands amid market tensions and heightened scrutiny of AI monetization across software, making guidance — and any read on AI-driven demand — a key watch for tech investors.
